build_voxelnet_model: build a VoxelNet 3D detector with voxel encoder, middle encoder, backbone, and bbox head
extract_feat_method: extract features from point cloud data using voxelization, encoding, and backbone layers
voxelize_points: apply hard voxelization to convert raw point cloud data into voxels with coordinates
forward_train_voxelnet: run the training forward pass computing losses from point clouds and ground truth 3D boxes
simple_test_voxelnet: run inference on point cloud data and return 3D bounding box predictions without augmentation
